description: Backstop CARC/RARC denial lexicon. Maps each Claim Adjustment Reason Code (CARC, 'CO-'/'PR-' prefixed) and Remittance Advice Remark Code (RARC, 'N'/'M' prefixed) to a normalized category, a payer-neutral canonical reason, and the default disposition the routing policy selects when no claim-specific override applies. default_route is one of RESUBMIT, APPEAL, PEER_TO_PEER, WRITE_OFF and mirrors backstop.domain.enums.RouteDecision.

CO-197.rebuttal_template: Prior authorization was obtained under reference {auth_ref}; the precertification was on file before the date of service {dos}. We request reprocessing of claim {claim_id} on the authorized authorization.

CO-198.canonical_reason: Precertification/notification absent for the level of care billed.
CO-198.rebuttal_template: The authorized level of care for {claim_id} matches the rendered service; precertification {auth_ref} covers the billed level of care.

CO-16.canonical_reason: Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing errors.
CO-16.rebuttal_template: The missing element flagged by remark {rarc} is supplied here: {missing_field}. We resubmit corrected claim {claim_id} with the required information.

CO-50.canonical_reason: Non-covered service deemed not medically necessary by the payer.
CO-50.rebuttal_template: The service on {claim_id} is medically necessary: the documented diagnosis {dx} and clinical findings meet the payer's own medical-policy criteria. We request a peer-to-peer review with the rendering physician.

CO-55.canonical_reason: Procedure/treatment deemed experimental or investigational by the payer.
CO-55.rebuttal_template: The procedure on {claim_id} is established standard of care, not experimental; peer-reviewed literature and the payer medical policy support coverage. We request a peer-to-peer review.

CO-45.canonical_reason: Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted amount.
CO-45.rebuttal_template: The amount above the contracted allowable on {claim_id} is a provider write-off per the participating agreement; no member balance applies.

CO-11.canonical_reason: Diagnosis inconsistent with the procedure code billed.
CO-11.rebuttal_template: The diagnosis-to-procedure linkage on {claim_id} is corrected: diagnosis {dx} supports procedure {cpt}. We resubmit the corrected claim.

CO-4.canonical_reason: Procedure code inconsistent with the modifier or a required modifier is missing.
CO-4.rebuttal_template: The required modifier for procedure {cpt} on {claim_id} is appended; we resubmit the corrected claim with the appropriate modifier.

CO-18.rebuttal_template: Claim {claim_id} is not a duplicate; it is a distinct date of service {dos}. If genuinely duplicate, no balance is pursued.

CO-29.canonical_reason: Time limit for filing the claim has expired.
CO-29.rebuttal_template: Claim {claim_id} was filed within the timely-filing window; proof of timely submission {proof_ref} is attached. We appeal the timely-filing denial.

PR-1.rebuttal_template: The deductible on {claim_id} is correctly applied as patient responsibility; this is billed to the member, not appealed to the payer.

PR-204.canonical_reason: Service/equipment/drug is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.
PR-204.rebuttal_template: The plan documents for {claim_id} list this service as a covered benefit on the effective plan; we appeal with the benefit-summary citation.

N130.canonical_reason: Consult plan benefit documents/guidelines for information about restrictions for this service.
N130.rebuttal_template: The plan benefit documents for {claim_id} contain no restriction excluding this service; the cited plan provision supports coverage. We appeal with the plan-document excerpt.

N115.canonical_reason: Decision based on a Local Coverage Determination (LCD) for medical necessity.
N115.rebuttal_template: The service on {claim_id} satisfies the cited LCD criteria; documentation supports each required element. We request a peer-to-peer review.

M127.canonical_reason: Missing patient medical record for this service.
M127.rebuttal_template: The requested medical records for {claim_id} are attached; we resubmit with the supporting documentation for date of service {dos}.
